concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-online-payments-payment-facilitators]] — 2026-09-15 online Checkout facilitator guide for scheme-required sub-merchant data, scoped user Merchant-of-Record wording, pre-live IDs and shopper descriptors; examples do not prove eligibility or funds flow.
warnings: Merchant-of-Record wording concerns the facilitated online transaction and card-scheme data; it does not set universal legal seller, payee, or fund ownership.
Required-parameters table includes email and phone but displayed request examples omit them; resolve actual payload rules with current Checkout contract and Adyen guidance.
No-store descriptor configuration is a separate conditional requirement; aggregated MID is stated for most payment methods only.
